summary: Phase-3 backend regression (39/39 pytest pass: 20 v2 + 19 v3) covering: new astro fields (lagna/lagna_lord/tithi/paksha/yoga/karan/nakshatra_lord) on /auth/me, kundali birth_details=15 rows with all expected labels, expanded interpretation library probed for 5 new combos (Brahmin/Kshatriya, Manav/Chatushpada, Horse/Buffalo, Sun/Moon Graha-Maitri, Dev/Manav Gana), PATCH /profile free-fields persistence + sensitive-field silent-ignore + empty-body 400, /profile/change-request create+409 duplicate+400 non-sensitive+listing-mine, /admin/* RBAC (403 for non-admin) + members list (no password_hash, _id stringified) + pending list + approve flips matches & recomputes astro on birth_time + reject blocks subsequent approve, /invites/send-email soft-fails with stub=true + share_link present + 403 non-creator + 404 unknown-code + 400 already-used. Frontend: /profile page works end-to-end for member (free-edit save+persist, change-request submit + appears in Your change requests, Lock icons render on sensitive fields), nav-profile and nav-admin (admin-only) icons present, non-admin /admin shows 'Admin only.' guard. CRITICAL FRONTEND BUG: admin user (profile_complete=false in seed_admin) is bounced to /onboarding when navigating to /admin (and /invitations) because the route Protected wrapper defaults needsProfile=true — admin UI is unreachable from the browser despite backend admin endpoints working perfectly. Email-it flow on Invitations is gated behind the same redirect for admin.

minor.issue: old_value computation uses `user.get(field) or user.get('astro',{}).get(field)` — for `looking_for`/`gender`/`dob`/`birth_time` this is fine because they live on the user doc, but the fallback to astro is dead code (none of the SENSITIVE_FIELDS exist under astro). Harmless but misleading.

admin_note is read from query string (`request: Request, admin_note: str = ''`) rather than from request body — works but unconventional REST shape. Frontend currently does not pass admin_note at all.

integration_issues.issue: Admin user (seeded with profile_complete=false) is force-redirected to /onboarding by <Protected needsProfile={true}> in /app/frontend/src/App.js (lines 51-53). Result: admin can NEVER reach /admin or /invitations in the browser even though Navbar shows the Crown 'Admin' link. Backend admin RBAC works correctly. Fix options: (a) seed admin with profile_complete=true in /app/backend/server.py seed_admin(), OR (b) wrap /admin route with <Protected needsProfile={false}>, OR (c) bypass needsProfile when user.role==='admin'.

rca of the issue: Frontend admin-UI unreachable — RCA: in /app/frontend/src/App.js the /admin route is wrapped with <Protected> whose default prop needsProfile=true. seed_admin() in /app/backend/server.py inserts the admin user with profile_complete=False. Therefore when admin navigates to /admin, Protected sees user.profile_complete===false and Navigates to /onboarding. Reproduction: login as admin@starsconnection.com / Admin@Stars2026 → Navbar shows Crown 'Admin' → click Admin → URL flips to /onboarding. Mitigation: easiest fix is `profile_complete: True` in seed_admin() insert_one (server.py line ~57); also makes Navbar 'Profile' link appear for admin if desired. Alternative: <Route path='/admin' element={<Protected needsProfile={false}><Admin /></Protected>} />.
